sentences.en: Who was going to organize these men into an army?
sentences.zh: 谁来把这些男人组织成一支军队？

sentences.en: William is so organized. He's always on top of things.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯做事很有条理。他总是能把事情处理得很好。

sentences.en: I think it's time for me to organize a party.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是时候我来举办一场派对了。
